purpose: Defines the values to prioritize and the things never to make a primary goal when writing or reviewing requirements and design documents, such as structural principles and bans on quantifying quality.
summary: Structural design principles to prioritize: responsibility split, boundaries, dependency direction
Dependency direction among generated documents: requirements, design, plan
Quality characteristics as outcomes, not direct numeric targets (Goodhart law)
Prohibited primary goals: quantifying structural quality, KPIs, fabricated unconfirmed values
Self-check criteria for design and review decisions
Pointer to the boundary spec for placing quantitative targets
Routing guide for review perspectives P1/P2/P3
Non-functional requirement category coverage with severity scoping
title: 要件定義書・設計書で優先すること
